entries.boundary: Shared identity, authority, data, destination, approval, audit, replay, and recovery decision
entries.required_proof: backend/src/security/trust_contract.py and backend/tests/test_trust_contract.py prove explicit grants, principal-operation matrix, exact session/job and resource scope, canonical digests, bounded attempt/replay/expiry checks, transformation binding, verified-audit receipt input, typed recovery, egress constraints, and exact approval drift; audit verification and replay sets are caller-authoritative rather than repository-backed/atomic

entries.boundary: LAN browser or client to reverse proxy and REST API
entries.required_proof: Authenticated request plus anonymous, expired, CSRF, forged-origin, replay, and unauthorized-mutation negatives

entries.boundary: Browser or channel client to WebSocket session
entries.required_proof: Authenticated upgrade, origin binding, expiry, reconnect, replay, and revocation tests

entries.boundary: Paired Mac edge or messaging identity to backend
entries.required_proof: Pairing, scoped identity, rotation, stale message, replay, and revocation enforcement

entries.boundary: Internal service or job identity outside the named scheduled-workflow path
entries.required_proof: Every internal caller uses a named service identity with exact session/job, least grant, expiry, resource scope, and audit lineage

entries.boundary: Scheduled workflow job to wrapped workflow capability
entries.required_proof: backend/src/approval/runtime.py, backend/src/scheduler/scheduled_jobs.py, and backend/tests/test_scheduled_jobs.py prove explicit SERVICE identity, exact session/job binding, CAPABILITY_EXECUTE-only grant, and context cleanup

entries.boundary: Backend to local model or VLM endpoint
entries.required_proof: Universal capability and endpoint validation, resolver/address pinning, redirect revalidation, classified payload, actual-route receipt, and failure behavior

entries.boundary: Strict-local synchronous completion candidate to primary or fallback transport
entries.required_proof: backend/src/llm_runtime.py and backend/tests/test_llm_runtime.py prove every local_runtime_only primary/fallback candidate is evaluated before transport; only trusted local provider kinds plus HTTP(S) localhost or literal RFC1918/ULA/loopback/link-local addresses pass, while free-form local capability, suffix, single-label, public, unspecified, and profile-spoof targets are not called

entries.boundary: Backend to OpenRouter or generic OpenAI-compatible endpoint
entries.required_proof: Data-class compatibility, destination allowlist, resolver pinning, redirect revalidation, pre-network redaction, zero-byte denial, and no silent fallback

entries.boundary: Untrusted model output to planner or capability request
entries.required_proof: Independent post-model authorization and hostile tool-call denial

entries.boundary: Web, browser, document, repository, message, or retrieved content to model context
entries.required_proof: Provenance retention and indirect prompt-injection tests through the real authorization path

entries.boundary: Planner request to tool or capability policy
entries.required_proof: Typed manifest, deny-by-default mode, principal, authority, destination, resource, and receipt enforcement

entries.boundary: Wrapped high-risk tool invocation to approval lookup or tool execution
entries.required_proof: backend/src/tools/approval.py and backend/tests/test_approval_tools.py prove wrapped high-risk/forced calls require explicit session/principal plus exact CAPABILITY_EXECUTE grant/session/job/resource scope; missing, under-scoped, or mismatched authority denies before repository/execution and model-origin arguments have no instruction authority

entries.boundary: Protected capability request to operator approval and consumption
entries.required_proof: Bound scope, expiry, single use, revocation, drift, replay, and no-session tests

entries.boundary: Protected capability decision and result to durable audit
entries.required_proof: Connect evaluator verified-audit receipt input to authoritative durable repository/outbox state; prove caller booleans cannot self-attest, storage failure denies before effect, and decision/result lineage is redacted

entries.boundary: Capability host to filesystem, subprocess, environment, and runtime resources
entries.required_proof: Root/path/symlink, environment, executable, timeout, output, cleanup, and resource-limit negatives

entries.boundary: Capability host to browser, network, download, upload, cookie, and private-address surfaces
entries.required_proof: Session partition, endpoint allowlist, redirect/DNS/SSRF, credential, download/upload, and hostile-content negatives

entries.boundary: Capability host to MCP, managed connector, or external account
entries.required_proof: Authenticated source identity, declared operation, destination/account scope, mutation approval, egress, and revocation

entries.boundary: Vault to opaque reference issuance and resolution
entries.required_proof: Preserve existing scoped resolution and extend it to every secret-bearing capability host

entries.boundary: Secret-bearing wrapped tool call to opaque reference resolution
entries.required_proof: backend/src/tools/secret_ref_tools.py, backend/src/security/trust_contract.py, and backend/tests/test_secret_ref_tools.py prove secret-bearing wrapped calls preflight the actual CREDENTIAL_EGRESS operation through shared principal_operation_reason before resolution, then evaluate capability scope; missing, unauthenticated, revoked, under-scoped, mismatched, SERVICE, and paired-edge authority denies even with grant strings; full destination-bound repository-backed durable credential approval/audit/replay remains downstream

entries.boundary: Secret-bearing data to remote model request, prompt, response, or stream
entries.required_proof: Secret-canary denial or pre-network redaction across model prompts, requests, provider errors, responses, and streams

entries.boundary: Secret-bearing data to artifact, checkpoint, migration, backup, restore, or report
entries.required_proof: Secret-canary denial, encryption, redaction, retention, restore, and revocation preservation across durable outputs

entries.boundary: Resolved capability secret to result, error, log, audit, or operator receipt
entries.required_proof: Secret-canary denial or redaction across capability results, errors, logs, durable audit, and operator receipts

entries.boundary: Vault key and encrypted values to migration, backup, restore, and rollback
entries.required_proof: Key separation, encrypted backup, restore, revocation preservation, no logging, and corrupt-archive denial

entries.boundary: Edge, channel, browser, connector, or capability output to artifact ingestion
entries.required_proof: Owner, provenance, data class, content type, active-content, integrity, size, and quarantine enforcement

entries.boundary: Opt-in governed artifact content to registry trust record
entries.required_proof: backend/src/artifacts/registry.py and backend/tests/test_artifact_registry.py prove exact canonical content digest, current allow decision, digested principal/source/provenance receipt metadata, secret-like metadata canaries, and legacy-unclassified behavior

entries.boundary: Stored artifact to consumer, model context, download, export, retention, or deletion
entries.required_proof: Allowed consumer/export, path/archive traversal, hash, retention, deletion, backup, and restore tests

entries.boundary: Recorded job, checkpoint, approval, or artifact to replay/resume
entries.required_proof: Preserve covered workflow drift blocking, adopt v1 lineage for every privileged durable path, and connect caller-authoritative replay inputs to an atomic durable reservation/consumption ledger

entries.boundary: Workspace, artifact, database, vault, backup, or migration failure to quarantine, restore, or rollback
entries.required_proof: Verified restore, incompatible-state quarantine, revocation preservation, key handling, and security-preserving data rollback

entries.boundary: Capability or external side effect to retry, resume, compensation, quarantine, or irreversible outcome
entries.required_proof: Typed recovery-class execution, independent authorization for compensation, replay safety, and truthful irreversible-effect handling

entries.boundary: Administrator or lifecycle command to GPU host services and private listeners
entries.required_proof: Private listener inventory, managed ownership, authenticated product transport, and SSH/admin separation

entries.boundary: HTTP, WebSocket, edge, or channel ingress to connection and request budgets
entries.required_proof: Connection/request rate limits, payload bounds, backpressure, cancellation, abuse recovery, and authenticated health behavior

entries.boundary: Model and VLM requests to the one-GPU queue and inference budgets
entries.required_proof: Serial admission, priority, cancellation, timeout, queue caps, interactive non-starvation, and background progress

entries.boundary: Artifact, backup, database, and workspace writes to storage budgets
entries.required_proof: Storage quotas, reserve policy, partial-write denial, retention, cleanup, disk-pressure recovery, and restore integrity

entries.boundary: Capability invocation to process, CPU, memory, network, output, time, and cost budgets
entries.required_proof: Per-capability limits, admission, timeout, cancellation, output bounds, cleanup, and cost enforcement

entries.boundary: All adopted security decisions to epic release and operator health receipt
entries.required_proof: Cumulative auth, egress, sandbox, replay, edge, backup, restart, rollback, redaction, and residual-risk gates
